premises-NL: A courier is assigned to a route if they have a valid license and are available on that day.
Route X requires a motorcycle license.
Route Y requires a car license.
Courier Minh has a motorcycle license.
Courier Minh is available on Monday.
Courier Lan has a car license.
Courier Lan is not available on Monday.
question: Which courier can be assigned to a route on Monday, and which route?
